| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

This recipe was found at ''Restaurant la Cascade''[http://www.southfrance.com/restaurants/cascade.html] in the Languedoc region of France.

==Ingredients==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 150 g peeled and [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] finely [[Cookbook:Grater|grated]] fresh [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]] root, divided
* 1 large [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrot]], peeled and chopped
* 1 L fresh, unsweetened [[Cookbook:Orange|orange juice]]
* 1 L fresh [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato juice]]
* 1 tsp dried [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]] powder
* 1 tsp chopped [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]]
* 1 sprig [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Bay Leaf|bay leaf]]
* 3 tsp minced stem ginger in syrup
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:salt|salt]]

==Procedure==
# Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the onions with 1 tsp grated ginger root, and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]], stirring, until translucent but not browned.
# Add the carrot, and [[Cookbook:Sweat|sweat]] for another few minutes.
# Add the orange and tomato juices, 1 tsp grated ginger root, the ginger powder, parsley, thyme, and bay leaf.
# Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], then [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for 40 minutes.
# Remove from the heat, and stir in the remaining 1 tsp grated ginger root along with the syruped stem ginger.
# [[Cookbook:Puréeing|Purée]] the mixture until smooth using a full-size or immersion [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]].
# Season with salt, taste, and adjust the seasoning as needed.
